title: Atomik runs can be approved inside /suites
gap: PageHead.tsx:28 '+ Run stage' and SpecInspector.tsx:61 'Run with Atomik / Approve N cr' both call atomik.start(). The gate UI (Approve / Not now, components/workspace/AtomikPanel.tsx:93-98) is mounted only in WorkspaceShell.tsx:170. When a run is waiting, run-engine.ts:226 start() returns 'waiting' and nothing else happens. The button is dead on Astra, Edit & Sound, Deliver, Business, Viral and every Atomik page.
target: When run.status==='waiting', SpecInspector shows the plan's steps and the gate: 'Approve · N cr' calls atomik.approve() and 'Not now' calls atomik.decline(). The PageHead run button opens the Inspector on the plan. Alternatively, port AtomikPanel as a gx drawer mounted in SuitesShell. While neither exists, hide '+ Run stage' on pages that have no gate.
respects_rules: Approval shows the exact price. The existing atomik-host approve and decline are used.
